_doc: t/246 held-out gold set for the disagreement_type classifier. Labelled by CL blind to each node's existing disagreement_type, from the same inputs the classifier sees (description + per-POV summary), applying rubric §2 with the §2.2 dominant-axis rule (broad structural, PI decision 2026-11-11). Committed before any classifier run on these ids.
drawn_by: seeded random draw (seed 4246) from live situations.json; strata by existing label (14 interpretive, 10 structural, 6 unlabelled), excluding the 10 rubric seeds, sit-484..493 and superseded nodes. Existing labels were hidden during labelling.
